Summary
  

  

Enterprise Systems is part of IS\&T and owns the technology behind Apple's SAP environment and its modernization through the SAP Landscape Modernization (SLM) initiative. The team manages the continuous operation, maintenance, and evolution of the world's largest single\-instance SAP deployment — a platform that sustains Apple's global supply chain and the integrity of its core financial systems.
  

  

Description
  

  

Apple’s Information Systems \& Technology (IS\&T) organization manages key business and technical infrastructure at Apple\- how online orders are placed, the customer experience with technology in our retail stores, how much network capacity we need around the world and much more. Apple’s Enterprise Systems organization is responsible to process end to end customer transactions in SAP \& Non\-SAP systems. This position will be responsible to implement \& manage S/4 at Apple in a fast paced environment. The candidate will be responsible to manage mid to large sized FICO / FICA / RAR projects. Responsible to architect and evaluate necessary transformative solutions leveraging AI and latest technologies. The responsibilities will include solution design, project timelines, and development scope definition. This position requires extensive engagement with business users and super users, gather business requirements, provide conceptual and detailed design to meet constantly evolving business needs. You will successfully deliver global \& complex projects in Apple's fast\-paced environment.
  

  

Minimum Qualifications  

  

  

* 8 years of SAP FICO or S/4 BRIM/FICA or S/4 RAR implementation experience
* 6 years of Solution Architect experience on mid\-to\-large SAP S/4 programs, with multiple full life\-cycle implementations in FICO, FICA, or S/4 RAR
* 6 years of experience evaluating and architecting solutions utilizing SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) for integrations with SAP S/4 systems
* 6 years of experience architecting end\-to\-end data flows across multiple integrated SAP and Non\-SAP systems (upstream and downstream), applying SAP Clean Core Strategy
* 6 years of finance domain expertise around ASC 606 / IFRS 15 compliance, multi\-element arrangements, contract modifications, etc. required for this role

* Demonstrated expertise designing high\-throughput, low\-latency financial processing architectures, including mass\-activity tuning, parallel batch optimization, and performance considerations at scale
* Proven track record delivering SAP finance transformation projects on time, partnering with cross\-functional internal and external teams

jobs.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAP BRIM Functional Data Analyst based in India.**
 Join a team supporting enterprise\-scale SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM) initiatives, with a focus on data analysis, quality, migration, and reporting. In this senior functional role, you will work across subscription management, charging, invoicing, and financial processes. You will help ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of critical billing and customer data throughout migration and integration activities. Working closely with business stakeholders, SAP specialists, architects, and technical teams, you will translate business needs into reliable functional data solutions. Your contributions will support effective reporting, sound financial reconciliation, and continuous process improvement. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact within complex enterprise SAP environments while supporting business\-critical operations.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

 In this role, you will contribute to SAP BRIM data analysis, migration, reporting, and governance activities, ensuring that enterprise billing and financial information remains accurate and reliable.
   

  

* Analyze and support SAP BRIM data structures and business processes across Subscription Order Management (SOM), Convergent Charging (CC), Convergent Invoicing (CI), and Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI\-CA).
* Support data\-related activities covering customer accounts, subscriptions, billing, invoicing, payments, and receivables management.
* Identify, investigate, and help resolve data quality issues across SAP BRIM environments.
* Develop and maintain source\-to\-target mapping documents, data transformation rules, validation procedures, and reconciliation documentation.
* Analyze legacy system data and support its mapping to SAP BRIM target structures.
* Contribute to data migration activities, including extraction, cleansing, transformation, loading, validation, and reconciliation.
* Collaborate with migration architects and technical teams to resolve migration defects and support mock conversions, cutover planning, and production deployments.
* Support the development and validation of billing reports, revenue and invoicing analytics, customer account reports, financial reconciliation reports, operational dashboards, and KPIs.
* Respond to business reporting and data analysis requests while ensuring outputs align with operational and regulatory requirements.
* Engage with stakeholders to gather and document data and reporting requirements, analyze business processes, and identify opportunities for improved data quality and process optimization.
* Translate business requirements into functional data specifications and support workshops and requirements\-gathering sessions.
* Work with SAP BRIM consultants, SAP S/4HANA teams, data architects, integration specialists, and developers to support data integration and reconciliation across connected systems.
* Develop and execute data validation scripts, test scenarios, user acceptance testing (UAT), and reconciliation tests.
* Track defects, investigate issues, validate end\-to\-end data flows, and verify reporting outputs.
* Maintain functional specifications, data dictionaries, governance documentation, reporting definitions, and operational procedures.
* Support enterprise data governance, compliance, audit requirements, and established data quality standards.
* Provide user support, troubleshooting assistance, and knowledge transfer to improve adoption of SAP BRIM data and reporting processes.

* At least 4 years of direct experience supporting SAP BRIM or related SAP billing environments.
* Proven experience with enterprise billing, invoicing, subscription management, and customer account processes.
* Strong understanding of SAP BRIM data structures and business processes, including billing and invoicing operations.
* Experience supporting data migration, data mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Solid knowledge of enterprise data management, data quality principles, reporting, analytics, and financial reconciliation.
* Practical experience with SQL, data analysis tools, SAP reporting tools, and SAP S/4HANA integrations.
* Ability to prepare functional specifications, testing documentation, and data governance materials.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
* Effective communication and stakeholder engagement skills, including the ability to facilitate workshops and requirements discussions.
* Strong organizational and documentation abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP BW/4HANA, or SAP Data Services (BODS).
* Familiarity with enterprise ETL platforms and reporting tools.
* Experience in utilities, telecommunications, transportation, finance, or subscription\-based industries.

* Previous consulting or contractor experience in enterprise SAP environments.


**Preferred Certifications**

jobs.title: Manager - SAP RAR
jobs.description:
Join Deloitte's SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You'll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP\-enabled solutions.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 1/15/2027\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a Manager on the SAP team, you will support clients across the solution lifecycle, from business process assessment through design, build, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live activities.
  

* Lead SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) design and delivery on SAP S/4HANA programs, from fit\-gap assessment through build, testing, cutover, and stabilization.
* Own solution design for ASC 606 and IFRS 15, including performance obligation determination, standalone selling price (SSP) allocation, variable consideration, contract modifications, and contract combinations.
* Assess and design solutions for complex revenue scenarios, including cross\-company contracts, percentage\-of\-completion, multi\-element arrangements, and in\-flight contract migration; support OCM capabilities and migration from CCM to OCM; and support integration between SD\-RAR and SOM\-RAR.
* Lead functional design and oversee configuration, data migration, testing, defect management, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and change adoption.
* Design RAR integrations with BRIM, Sales and Distribution (SD) and billing, Project Systems, configure\-price\-quote (CPQ) platforms, Universal Journal, and reporting and analytics; apply SAP BRF\+ and other SAP capabilities to support rules\-based determination and address solution gaps through Clean Core\-aligned options, including Business Technology Platform (BTP) extensions, hybrid approaches, and controlled custom development.
* Advise client stakeholders on RAR design decisions and their business or compliance implications; contribute to proposals, client presentations, and key design\-decision documentation; and mentor and review team members' work while supporting quality, knowledge transfer, stakeholder communications, and training.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  

**The team**  

  

Deloitte's SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP\-enabled transformations across core business functions. Our teams combine industry knowledge, functional experience, and technology capabilities to support first\-time implementations, business\-led enhancements, and large\-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.  

  

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to modernize operations, improve process performance, and unlock value through cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required**  

* Bachelor's degree, or Associate's degree plus 10\+ years of experience in SAP, ERP, or consulting
* 8\+ years of SAP consulting experience supporting solution design and end\-to\-end delivery in a consulting firm, industry environment, or both
* 4\+ years of SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) experience, including solution design and hands\-on configuration supporting ASC 606 or IFRS 15 requirements
* Experience delivering at least 2 full\-lifecycle SAP RAR implementations or migrations, with a primary delivery or workstream leadership role on at least 1; at least 1 must be on SAP S/4HANA
* Experience designing a solution for at least 1 of the following revenue scenarios: cross\-company contract combinations, percentage\-of\-completion, or multi\-element SSP allocation
* Experience presenting SAP RAR design decisions to client stakeholders
* Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

  

**Preferred**  

* 2\+ years of client service delivery experience in a consulting or professional services firm supporting transformation engagements
* SAP certification in S/4HANA Finance, RAR, or Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM), or a CPA or CA credential.
* Experience with BRF\+ for rules\-based determination (POB, SSP) and moving custom ECC logic to Clean Core\-compliant designs.
* Experience with in\-flight contract migration, opening\-balance reconciliation, and SOX / audit trail design.
* Experience with pre\-sales and orals, including proposal contributions.
* Experience evaluating or applying SAP Business AI or Joule use cases involving contract and performance obligation interpretation, AI\-assisted standalone selling price estimation, ABAP remediation, or continuous controls monitoring , including documentation of human\-review considerations.

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled.
